name: pair_target_construction_integrity
purpose: Verify pair labels are constructible, non-ambiguous, and not dominated by ties.

name: LOSO_pair_leakage_guard
purpose: Verify subject-disjoint train/validation folds and no pair/reversed-pair leakage.

name: pair_retention_balance_audit
purpose: Check retention, label balance, and fold coverage.

name: position_and_majority_baseline_control
purpose: Ensure pair order, majority class, or fold artifacts cannot solve the task.

name: metric_sanity_control
purpose: Verify pairwise metrics behave correctly for perfect/random/shuffled predictions.

name: reproducibility_guard
purpose: Ensure any smoke-test script/report is committed or archived before scientific continuation.
